chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:

"Wudu (ablution) is a mudd, and ghusl (ritual bath) is a sa'. There will come people after me who will regard that as too little; those are against my sunnah (prophetic tradition). The one who remains firm upon my sunnah (prophetic tradition) will be with me in the enclosure of holiness."

key_terms.الْوُضُوءُ: wudu (ablution), the ritual washing before acts of worship
key_terms.حَظِيرَةِ الْقُدْسِ: the enclosure of holiness, referring to a sacred abode in the hereafter
key_terms.سُنَّتِي: my sunnah (prophetic tradition), the Prophet’s صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم normative practice
key_terms.صَاعٌ: a sa', a larger standard measure of water
key_terms.مُدٌّ: a mudd, a specific measured quantity of water

ai.seo_question: What did the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم prescribe as the amount of water for wudu and ghusl?
ai.summary: This hadith states the prophetic measure for water used in wudu (ablution) and ghusl (ritual bath), teaching moderation and adherence to the sunnah (prophetic tradition). It warns against departing from the Prophet’s صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم practice and promises nearness to him in the hereafter for those who remain steadfast upon his sunnah.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.70 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said:

"Ablution (wudu) is a mud (a specific measure), and ghusl (ritual washing) is a saa' (a larger measure). There will come people after me who will underestimate these amounts, and those will be contrary to my Sunnah.
The one who adheres to my Sunnah will be with me in the enclosure of holiness (Paradise)."
